title: Paint by the Bucket
description: Paint by the Bucket — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Kent the Artisan

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 7 Buckets each of Grey, Green, and Red Paint. Afterward, return to Artisan Kent on Level 1 of Algernon.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Sir Kent the Artisan

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Paint by the Bucket

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 7 Buckets each of Grey, Green, and Red Paint. Afterward, return to Artisan Kent on Level 1 of Algernon.

Offer:

To be honest, I really do not want to have to ever set foot into Townston again if I can help it. I mean, you can practically see all of the germs crawling around that place! People coughing and not covering their mouths, not washing their hands after running dungeons, and talking to each other. Spare me! So, with that in mind, I will gladly pay you if you continue to bring me buckets of paint.

You know what to do right? Good! Once you have all the Buckets of Paint you need to return to me, Sir Kent the Artisan, here on the first level of Algernon. Deliver them to me and I will pay you accordingly.

Turn-in:

Excellent! At this rate I will never want for paint again. That is, unless I want to start using more than these three colors. Anyway, I will deal with that when it is time to cross that bridge. Here is something for you. Let me know if you are ready to gather some more paint.

Objectives:

  • Grey Paint ×7
  • Green Paint ×7
  • Red Paint ×7

Level range: 3–20
